knowledge.name: Synthetic permit and license register
knowledge.detail: Fixed records provide facility, authority, permit number, status, type, expiration, conditions, lead time, and inspections.

knowledge.name: Synthetic application status snapshot
knowledge.detail: Submitted applications record facility, authority, filing date, review status, expected decision, and public comments.

knowledge.name: Regulatory requirement mappings
knowledge.detail: Bundled air, water, waste, pipeline, and spill-control requirements support evidence-gap screening only.

knowledge.name: Rules, controls, and locked evidence
knowledge.detail: Packaged controls define routing, calculations, exact demo anchors, synthetic limits, and prohibited legal or filing claims.

intelligence_processing.name: Facility-scoped permit consolidation
intelligence_processing.detail: Filters the fixed register by facility and summarizes active and expired permits with source-backed identifiers and dates.

intelligence_processing.name: Renewal calendar prioritization
intelligence_processing.detail: Sorts expiration dates and lead times into a planning calendar without initiating renewal, notice, or authority submission.

intelligence_processing.name: Compliance evidence-gap triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Flags expired permits and requirements at risk by severity while withholding any legal compliance determination.

intelligence_processing.name: Submitted-application monitoring
intelligence_processing.detail: Reports recorded application stage, authority, filing date, expected decision, and comments without changing the filing.

intelligence_processing.name: Deterministic intent routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Routes four persona questions to explicit operations, preserves exact evidence, and fails closed when records are absent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable RAPP Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Local chat and API routes expose one credential-free, read-only agent with four independently callable operations.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two knowledge files support persona-led previews in an integrated-auth Draft agent that remains unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first compliance responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Answers lead with the record, explain uncertainty, name the authorized reviewer and connection, and end with the no-write boundary.

management_reporting.name: Permit inventory review
management_reporting.detail: Shows permit identity, facility, authority, status, expiration, and conditions for facility and compliance review.

management_reporting.name: Renewal planning calendar
management_reporting.detail: Orders upcoming and expired permits by date and lead time so permit coordinators can prepare an authorized review queue.

management_reporting.name: Compliance gap review
management_reporting.detail: Surfaces critical expired-permit evidence and high-risk requirements for permit staff and legal review, not legal advice.

management_reporting.name: Application status brief
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes already-submitted applications and review stages for environmental counsel without implying a new filing occurred.

tools.name: Portable PermitLicenseManagementAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent provides four deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable agent and exposes chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft pilot with four skills and two knowledge files; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Permit system of record
tools.detail: Approved future least-privilege source for current permit records; the packaged pilot has no live connection.

tools.name: SharePoint controlled documents
tools.detail: Approved production seam for governed permit evidence; the current package uses two bundled synthetic knowledge files.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 case management
tools.detail: Approved future seam for review cases and handoffs; the current agent does not create, update, or close cases.

tools.name: Approved authority portal connector
tools.detail: Future authenticated filing seam isolated from analysis and gated by authorization, current-state checks, and confirmation.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams authorized review
tools.detail: Future collaboration seam for reviewer handoffs and approvals; the current package sends no messages or approval requests.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: All organizations, identifiers, dates, statuses, measurements, and recommendations are fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Permit inventory, renewal calendar, compliance gaps, and application status remain independently routable and reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed record handling
supporting_features.detail: Unknown identifiers produce no substitutions, and the agent does not browse, enrich, or invent missing permit evidence.

supporting_features.name: Non-legal compliance boundary
supporting_features.detail: Gap findings are triage evidence, not legal advice or proof of compliance, approval, renewal, or filing status.

supporting_features.name: Human authorization and approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Authorized permit owners and legal or regulatory reviewers retain every decision and external action.

supporting_features.name: Read-only workflow governance
supporting_features.detail: No permit is submitted, renewed, amended, withdrawn, approved, or changed in an external system by the agent.

supporting_features.name: Validated draft and future-write controls
supporting_features.detail: Four locked cases pass; publishing is separate, and future writes require confirmation, error handling, and immutable audit logs.
